name: skilder
description: Connect any agent to a Skilder workspace, where AI builders orchestrate the capabilities their agents use: plugins composed of skills, MCP tools and MCP Apps, served live over MCP and governed there.

interface.longDescription: Skilder is where AI builders orchestrate the capabilities their agents use at work. A builder composes plugins from skills, MCP tools and MCP Apps, publishes them to a workspace, and Skilder serves them live to any agent over MCP: the right plugin for the task, under the workspace's permissions and guardrails, with a record of every call. This plugin is the entry point. It connects the agent to the workspace with a browser sign-in, then the agent starts each task with init_skilder, learns the plugin the workspace suggests, and runs its skills, tools and MCP Apps through Skilder, with every call recorded against a session. Plugins, skills, tools and Apps are served live by the workspace and never bundled here.
defaultPrompt: Use Skilder to find the plugin that fits this task and do it with its skills, tools and Apps.
Use Skilder to show the plugins my workspace publishes.
